chapter: Happy Land, sidemen and other bands
title: Sorting out the sidemen: Roy, Nolan Williams, the two Bennys
summary: The three argue over which Benny Turner or Benny Toyner played piano and where he lived, and recall a drummer named Roy.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
